final_status: method sealed 2/2; all night action trials stopped; full same-version whole-body transfer not achieved

comparison_with_N17.reason: real ordered M8 M9 M10 handovers and better front wrapping; N19C has no new handover
comparison_with_N17.N17_missing: newly received M8 M9 M10 return toward corner; M11 and all21 coherent target helix still absent
comparison_with_N17.N19_reusable_components: continuous physical hinge-reference increments; exact original FK and analytic Jacobian; original shell prediction; rejected candidate does not commit shift or ctrl
comparison_with_N17.N19_limitation: 1211/2701 no-feasible steps, sustained from 76.75s; explicit bearing-registered limited joint fit does not yet yield continuous body transport
comparison_with_N17.comparison_caveat: better N19 wrapping than N18 is partly after command/window freeze; it is not evidence of sustained transport
comparison_with_N17.N19_missing_material_frame_caveat: initial calibration is retained, but after the first solve the independent transported material frame affects only recorded unused integral seed; fit location uses measured carrying-body frame plus one-step rolling prediction. This is a candidate limitation, not a proven unique cause.
